tools: Floor jack and two jack stands
Brake cleaner and a wire brush
safety: Car on jack stands, never just the jack
Wear eye protection; brake dust and cleaner spray are harmful
Never press the brake pedal while the caliper is off

steps.text: Loosen the lug nuts half a turn with the wheel still on the ground.
steps.warning: Park on level ground with the parking brake on
steps.check_goal: Wheel on the ground, every lug nut cracked loose

steps.text: Jack up the car, set it on jack stands, and remove the wheel.
steps.warning: Place the stands under the marked jacking points
steps.check_goal: Car resting on a jack stand, wheel off, caliper visible

steps.text: Remove the two caliper guide pin bolts.
steps.warning: Support the caliper; never let it hang by the brake hose
steps.check_goal: Both guide pin bolts removed, caliper lifted off the bracket

steps.text: Hang the caliper from the spring with a bungee.
steps.warning: Keep the brake hose slack, never twisted or stretched
steps.check_goal: Caliper hanging from a bungee, hose slack

steps.text: Slide the old pads and their clips out of the bracket.
steps.spec: Replace pads below 3 mm of friction material
steps.check_goal: Caliper bracket empty, old pads removed

steps.text: Clean the bracket slides, then fit new clips and new pads.
steps.warning: Keep grease and cleaner off the pad friction surface
steps.check_goal: New pads seated in the bracket with the friction side facing the rotor

steps.text: Press the piston fully back with the C-clamp and an old pad.
steps.warning: Watch the brake fluid reservoir so it does not overflow
steps.check_goal: Piston flush with the caliper body

steps.text: Refit the caliper over the pads and torque the guide pin bolts.
steps.check_goal: Caliper back on the bracket, both guide pin bolts installed

steps.text: Refit the wheel, lower the car, torque the lug nuts, and pump the pedal until firm.
steps.spec: Lug nuts 100-140 Nm in a star pattern
steps.warning: Pump the brake pedal before driving; the first press goes to the floor
steps.check_goal: Wheel back on, car on the ground
